title: dose.sale_limits input
description: The sales to answer, in order (a bulk sell's copies in one call): each sale's lines, one per record and dose, with the units it sells.

record.description: The state's package record the units come from; only weightPerUnit (g) and analyteWeight (mg/g of raw psilocybin) are read. Any JSON value has an answer: a figure that isn't a usable number (not a number, negative, a billion or more, or more than 6 decimal places) refuses the sale, and one that is null, absent or 0 too.

qty.description: The units sold. Any JSON value has an answer: anything but an integer from 0 to a million refuses the sale.
